name: Leane
source:
A priest of mixed dark elf and human blood. She is self-indulgent and outspoken, yet gentle and caring toward others. Deemed an undesirable for her half-blood status, she wandered for some time before being taken in by the church. She has been a "servant" for years. As a veteran, she oversees the training of new arrivals and is responsible for Lufia's care and breaking in.

[Translated from the [url=https://nexton-net.jp/ms-toybox/darkone/lufia/#chara]official website[/url]]
